Native-safe / unavailable-behaviour notes (rules 4-7): react-i18next, lucide-react, @/lib/cn, framer-motion (via FadeIn), the DOM ThemeProvider theme engine, the window-CustomEvent/localStorage tour state machine, and localStorage-backed prefs + the cross-tab `storage` event have no native parity — mapped to View/AppText/Switch/Pressable + StyleSheet + emoji Glyph, with in-memory useSyncExternalStore stores and explicit no-ops/unavailable states documented in nativeAppearanceCapabilities { themeEngineAvailable:false, tourStateMachineAvailable:false, persistentPreferencesAvailable:false, crossTabSyncAvailable:false }.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — only React + react-native primitives (Pressable/StyleSheet/Switch/View), the native shared AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens, and the web-parity FadeIn + useSettings/useSaveSettings + StatusBar prefs store.
